text.description_html:
8300 Series Heavy-Duty Grade 1 Rim Exit Device with Polished Brass Finish

Tell Manufacturing, Inc. was incorporated in 1986 as a manufacturer and distributor of commercial locks and door hardware. Tell has expanded its customer profiles to include, contract hardware distribution, locksmith distributors, OEM manufacturers, and the modular office industry.

These Brass finish 8300's are popular with resort hotels or anywhere you want to add a sense of decor, rather that using a bland commercial aluminum exit device.

  • Certification: ANSI A156.3, 1994, Grade 1, UL Listed
  • Rail: Fits 28" to 36" doors
  • Latch: Stainless steel 5/8" throw
  • Backset: 2 3/4"
  • Strike: Adjustable with slotted holes for adjustments
  • Fasteners: Accomodates wood or metal doors
  • Door Range: 1 3/4" to 2" thickness
  • Door Preparation: Surface Mounted
  • Warranty: 10 year limited

US3 - Polished Brass Finish.
